promotions.story: thebingejournal 4 great restaurants in one Hyderabad hotel 👇 📍 Kanak - The incredible team of chefs here explore Indian cuisine with depth, without limiting themselves to the usual ‘bestseller’ dishes that you often see in so many Indian fine-dining menus. We look forward to hosting you at Kanak for brunch & dinner.
promotions.full: thebingejournal 4 great restaurants in one Hyderabad hotel 👇 📍 Kanak - The incredible team of chefs here explore Indian cuisine with depth, without limiting themselves to the usual ‘bestseller’ dishes that you often see in so many Indian fine-dining menus. We especially love their hyper-regional food festivals that dive into cuisines that often don’t get their due. 📍 Tuscany - Constantly innovating, Tuscany’s menu could even surprise seasoned Italian food aficionados. promotions.story: Some Italian favourites are worth making room for. From the bright, comforting flavours of Lemon Chicken Risotto to the creamy indulgence of Tiramisu, let Tuscany take you through a little savoury-to-sweet journey. Join us at Tuscany in Trident, Hyderabad and savour the classics. We look forward to hosting you at Tuscany.
